text: The Haas F1 partner is Fix Network, the trading name of Mondofix Inc., a Blainville, Quebec company running the Fix Auto, NOVUS Glass and ProColor franchise networks. President and CEO Steve Leal joined as a franchisee, led a buyout to become largest shareholder of Fix Auto Canada in 2013 and took majority control in 2015 - private Canadian ownership, no state stake. Nothing suggests a state or conflict link; the sponsor is a franchised collision-repair operator.
